Our Services

Drains, Sewers, Pipes & Plumbing — Handled In-House

From a stubborn clog to a full re-pipe, our skilled technicians use cutting-edge technology to deliver solid, long-lasting solutions for your home or business.

Drain Cleaning & Rooter Service

Fast, dependable clearing for clogged drains and main lines — done cleanly and done right.

  • Drain cleaning
  • Rooter service
  • Main line stoppages

Sewer Repair & Replacement

Complete sewer solutions, from targeted repairs to full replacements and trenchless options.

  • Sewer repair & replacement
  • Trenchless pipe lining
  • Drain re-piping

Hydro Jetting

High-pressure water jetting scours grease, scale and roots from the inside of your sewer line.

  • Sewer line cleaning
  • Root & grease removal
  • Preventive maintenance

Sewer Camera Inspection

We pinpoint the problem inside your line on camera before recommending any repair — no guesswork.

  • Camera line inspection
  • Problem diagnosis
  • Free for first-time customers

Water Heaters & Tankless

Repair and replacement of standard and tankless water heaters — including commercial 75–100 gallon tanks.

  • Water heater replacement
  • Tankless water heaters
  • Commercial water heaters

Copper & PEX Re-Piping

Whole-home re-pipes with quality materials — copper, PEX, gas and drain lines, made to spec.

  • Copper re-piping
  • PEX re-piping
  • Gas re-piping

About Us

A Family Business That Treats Your Home Like Its Own

LC Doctor Plumber Inc. is a family owned and operated company with over 15 years of experience in the plumbing industry. Along with the knowledge we've gathered through the years, the most important thing we've learned is to truly value our clients.

We build long-term relationships — becoming the go-to company our clients call for any plumbing concern, and the one they recommend to family and friends. Big or small, we complete every job quickly and efficiently, using high-quality materials and the latest technology.

Residential & CommercialService, repairs, remodeling and new construction.
Professional TechniciansHighly knowledgeable, courteous, clean appearance.
Safety FirstProfessional projects, made to specs and regulations.
Clients FirstSolutions, not problems — satisfaction is our top priority.
